Title: Jev vs Laya: hosted vs local decisions
URL: https://jevmodel.org/jev-vs-laya/
Published: 2026-09-25
Author: N/A
Highlights:
Jev is a managed API; Laya is open weights you can run on your hardware. Laya claims 32.8 ms latency against 236 to 276 ms for Jev.
